title: Finite locally constant pullback on each pulled-back stratum
statement: Given a stratification S of X and a constructible abelian étale sheaf E whose set pullback to every S-stratum is finite locally constant, the set pullback of the abelian inverse image along g to every stratum of S.pullback g is finite locally constant.

proof.text: Use the existing private finiteLocallyConstant_of_iso from Sheaf.AlgebraicGeometry.PullbackFiniteLocallyConstant through import all. Its proof keeps the trivializing cover and transports each geometric fiber. No helper is duplicated in this module.
For each i, the component at E of etaleInverseImageAlgebraicStructures for S.immersion i compares the underlying abelian inverse image and the set inverse image. Transport hS i along its inverse.

Apply pullback_finite_locally_constant to pullback.fst (S.immersion i) g, S.immersion i and E with the transported hypothesis. Take its second conjunct, finite local constancy for the composite inverse image.

Stratification.pullback makes the new immersion pullback.snd (S.immersion i) g. The Cartesian-square equation equates its composite with g to the first projection followed by the old immersion. Transport the abelian pullback along this equation, then use Etale.upperStarComp. Forget groups and transport finite local constancy with the proved helper.

The abelian inverse-image comparison for the new immersion identifies the underlying abelian pullback with the set pullback of the underlying abelian inverse image along g. Transport the result using the proved helper to obtain the conclusion for i.

lean.statement:
theorem finiteLocallyConstant_pullback_stratum
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : Y ⟶ X)
    (E : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (S : Stratification X)
    (hS : ∀ i : Fin S.n, IsFiniteLocallyConstantEtaleSheafOfSets
      ((etaleSetPullback (S.immersion i)).obj
        ((sheafCompose X.smallEtaleTopology
          (CategoryTheory.forget AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})).obj E))) :
    ∀ i : Fin S.n, IsFiniteLocallyConstantEtaleSheafOfSets
      ((etaleSetPullback ((S.pullback g).immersion i)).obj
        ((sheafCompose Y.smallEtaleTopology
          (CategoryTheory.forget AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})).obj
          ((Etale.upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} g).obj E)))
